lanes.description: Directly creates, writes, appends, moves, copies, deletes, or replaces filesystem content, or is the immediate semantic wrapper performing that effect. Reading, hashing, stat, and path construction alone do not qualify.
Starts or directly invokes an external process, shell command, server, model worker, or executable adapter. Merely describing a command or rendering command text does not qualify.
Creates or changes durable traveler, workforce, qualification, health, reservation, schedule, candidate, telemetry, or other factory state. Local variables and read-only projections do not qualify.

Immediately validates confirmation, authorization, qualification, identity, content binding, invariant, or policy before an effect or transition is allowed. General validation unrelated to authority does not qualify.
Performs or authorizes promotion, apply, release, reservation, dispatch, production start, or another transition that increases authority over live work. Read-only recommendations do not qualify.
Restores prior state, compensates or rolls back a failed effect, cleans transactional residue, recovers after interruption, or verifies restoration. Ordinary error reporting does not qualify.
